Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r187/src/extras/lib/earcut.js
Licence: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mapbox/earcut/v3.0.2/LICENSE

Additional upstream credits

The Three.js HDRLoader credits Bruce Walter's RGBE routines for the RGBE parser.
Source: https://www.graphics.cornell.edu/~bjw/rgbe.html

The Three.js closest-point-on-triangle implementation credits the algorithm in
Real-Time Collision Detection by Christer Ericson, section 5.1.5, published by
Morgan Kaufmann Publishers. Copyright 2005 Elsevier Inc.
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r187/src/math/Triangle.js

Earcut credits Simon Tatham's linked-list mergesort for its list-sorting method.
Source: https://www.chiark.greenend.org.uk/~sgtatham/algorithms/listsort.html
